environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate task in private subnet. Task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with explicit tmpfs mounts only at /tmp (size 64MB, noexec). The container runs as non-root UID 1000 (user: '1000:1000' in task def). Network configuration: task is in private subnet with no NAT gateway — egress is only through a VPC endpoint for ECR (to pull images) and a VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs. No internet egress path exists. The ALB in front has an AWS WAF WebACL attached with: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY set to 4KB, (2) a custom rate-limit rule of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP, and (3) a geo-restriction blocking all regions except us-east-1 edge locations. The ECS task IAM role has zero permissions (empty policy document). The WEBHOOK_SECRET is set to a 64-byte random value stored in Secrets Manager and injected via valueFrom in the container definition.

config.network: private subnet, no NAT, no IGW
